hero.liveTag: Live — Autumn is answering calls now
hero.headline: Your receptionist, available 24/7.
hero.subhead: Autumn answers every call instantly, books appointments directly into your calendar, handles rescheduling, answers client questions, and upsells add-ons — all without you lifting a finger.

intro.heading: A receptionist who never puts a caller on hold.
intro.body: Autumn is deeply integrated with your Certxa account. From the moment she's activated, she knows every service you offer, every staff member's schedule, your business hours, and your booking rules.

bullets.text: Books, reschedules, and cancels appointments in real time
Knows how busy the salon is right now and gives callers a real wait time
Tells callers whether a provider is working today, and whether they are free or with a client
Answers questions about services, prices, and availability
Upsells add-ons and premium services on every call
Recognises returning clients and personalises the experience
Fills calendar gaps and keeps your schedule fully booked

capabilities.heading: Everything a great receptionist does, without the overhead.

items.title: Instant answer, every time
items.body: Autumn picks up within two seconds, rain or shine. No more missed calls while your providers are mid-service.

items.title: Real-time booking
items.body: She sees live availability across all staff and books — or reschedules — directly into your Certxa calendar.

items.title: Built-in upselling
items.body: Autumn naturally suggests add-ons and upgrades on every call, increasing your average ticket without any training.

items.title: Client recognition
items.body: Returning clients are greeted by name. Autumn knows their history and can pull up their last appointment.

items.title: Follows your rules
items.body: Walk-ins only, appointments only, no same-day bookings, a walk-in cutoff — Autumn only offers what your salon actually accepts.

items.title: Live salon awareness
items.body: While you're open, Autumn sees who is clocked in, who is free, who is with a client and how many people are waiting — and tells callers the real wait.

items.title: After-hours answering
items.body: When the salon is closed Autumn says so, then keeps booking, rescheduling and answering questions. She never pretends someone is in the building.

items.title: Only real answers
items.body: Hours, prices, services and wait times come straight from your Certxa account. If Autumn doesn't have a fact, she says so instead of guessing.

items.title: Spam protection
items.body: Robocalls, telemarketers, and obvious loops are ended in the first few seconds — so your balance is spent on real clients.

items.title: Natural conversation
items.body: Autumn sounds warm, professional, and human. Callers routinely can't tell she isn't your front-desk team.

items.title: Always up to date
items.body: Change your services, hours, or staff? Autumn syncs automatically — no retraining required.

items.title: Zero setup friction
items.body: Autumn reads your Certxa account from day one. You're live in minutes, not days.

liveAwareness.heading: Autumn knows what's happening in your salon right now.
liveAwareness.intro: A caller asks "Can I come in now?" A receptionist standing at the front desk would look around before answering. Autumn does the same.

items.title: A real wait time
items.body: "There's no wait right now" or "It's about twenty minutes" — worked out from who is in a chair, who is waiting and who is free.

items.title: Who is working today
items.body: Autumn knows which providers are clocked in. She won't send a caller in for someone who isn't there.

items.title: Free, busy, or on a break
items.body: For each provider she can see whether they're free, with a client or on a break, and roughly when they'll be free next.

items.title: How busy the salon is
items.body: Clients in service and clients waiting are counted live, so "we're quiet, come on in" and "we're busy this afternoon" are both true when she says them.

items.title: Your walk-in rules
items.body: If you've stopped taking walk-ins, or it's past your walk-in cutoff, Autumn doesn't invite anyone in. She offers an appointment instead.

items.title: Open hours only
items.body: Live answers are given while the salon is open. After closing, Autumn tells callers the salon is closed and helps them book for another time.

setup.heading: Up and running in minutes.
setup.body: Autumn works with the data already inside your Certxa account. There's nothing to configure from scratch.

steps.title: Load your account balance
steps.body: Head to the Autumn section in your Certxa dashboard and add credit to your account. You choose how much to load.

steps.title: Activate Autumn
steps.body: Enable Autumn with one click. She reads your services, staff, and calendar automatically — no manual setup.

steps.title: Forward your calls
steps.body: Point your salon phone to Autumn's number. She starts answering immediately. Your plan's included calls are used first; after that each call is $0.50 from your balance.

pricing.heading: Pay for what Autumn actually uses.
pricing.body: Autumn is available on every Certxa plan. There's no extra subscription — instead you load funds into your account and Autumn draws from that balance as she handles calls.

points.title: Load your balance
points.body: Add any amount to your Autumn credit balance directly from your Certxa dashboard. It pays for calls beyond the ones your plan includes. Funds never expire.

points.title: Autumn handles calls
points.body: Your plan covers 20, 50 or 100 calls a month. After that, each call is $0.50 from your balance. Nothing is charged when she's idle.

points.title: Auto top-up (optional)
points.body: Set a low-balance threshold and Certxa will top up your account automatically — so Autumn never stops mid-day.

pricing.planNote: Included on Certxa plans — 20 calls a month on Solo, 50 on Starter and 100 on Professional. Additional calls are $0.50 each. There is a one-time $15 activation fee for your dedicated phone number. Free trials don't include calls; a trial's calls are $0.50 each.

items.question: Do I need a separate subscription for Autumn?
items.answer: No. Autumn comes with your Certxa plan: 20 calls a month on Solo, 50 on Starter and 100 on Professional. After that, each additional call is $0.50. There is a one-time $15 activation fee for your dedicated phone number. Free trials don't include calls; a trial's calls are $0.50 each.

items.question: How does the credit balance work?
items.answer: Your plan's included calls are used first. Once they are used up, each additional call is $0.50, taken from the credit balance you top up inside your Certxa dashboard. You can set a low-balance auto top-up so she never goes offline mid-day.

items.question: Does Autumn know how busy my salon is?
items.answer: Yes. While your salon is open, Autumn sees who is clocked in, who is free, who is with a client and how many people are waiting. She uses that to tell a caller whether there is a wait and roughly how long. She never makes up a wait time: if there isn't enough information, she says so.

items.question: Can a caller ask whether a specific provider is available?
items.answer: Yes. Autumn can say whether that provider is working today, whether they are free or with a client right now, and roughly when they will be free.

items.question: What does Autumn do when the salon is closed?
items.answer: She tells the caller the salon is closed and acts as your after-hours answering service: booking, rescheduling, cancelling and answering questions. She does not give live wait times after hours, and she never implies anyone is at the salon.

items.question: Does Autumn need training before she can take calls?
items.answer: No. From the moment you enable her, Autumn already knows your services, staff members, schedule, business hours, and pricing — pulled directly from your Certxa account. Setup takes minutes.

items.question: What happens if my credit balance runs out?
items.answer: Autumn will stop taking new calls until the balance is topped up. We'll notify you well in advance and the optional auto top-up feature means you'll rarely run dry.

items.question: Can callers tell they're speaking to an AI?
items.answer: Autumn is designed to sound warm, natural, and professional. Many callers don't realise she isn't your front-desk team. If a caller specifically asks whether they're speaking to an AI, Autumn will answer honestly.

items.question: Does Autumn work for multi-location businesses?
items.answer: Yes. Autumn can be enabled independently per location, each with its own credit balance and configuration — ideal for salon groups and franchise owners.

cta.heading: Your phone is ringing. Is Autumn there?
cta.subhead: Start your free 60-day trial and turn Autumn on from day one. Calls during the trial are $0.50 each.
